title: fix(cli): os migrate value walks name the columns a disabled package's extension adds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DCWRqxf2Z2WsHK3FdNXwnEU)_

Fixes #30626

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os migrate` 的五个值迁移命令(blank-single-values、blank-multi-values、option-codes、text-scalars、value-shapes)在报告里逐条列出因所属模块包被停用而没读到的列(对象.字段 + 包 id),`--json` 里同名 `withheldColumns`。
- 为什么改:模块包停用时,它扩展到别的对象上的字段从对外对象里隐去、但列和数据还在;这几个命令只看对外对象,于是跳过这些列,报告却像全扫过一样(实测:有待清理的空串,dry run 仍报「未发现」)。
- 风险与回滚:只加报告行和一个 JSON 字段,读写范围一行没变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/migrate-withheld-columns.ts`(判定:存储折叠减对外折叠,按停用扩展包归属);`blank-single-values.ts` 的 `walkBlankColumns` 返回处;`value-shapes.ts`(无列规则,列出全部被隐去字段)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/migrate/withheld-extension-columns.integration.test.ts`,预期 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/cli/src/utils/migrate-withheld-columns.ts`: `withheldColumns(engine, objects, select?)` reads, per walked object, the extend contributors whose package `isPackageDisabled`, takes the walk's own column rule over `registry.getStorageObject(object)` minus the same rule over the served `engine.getObject(object)`, and attributes each remaining column to the disabled package whose extension declares it. `formatWithheldColumns` renders the list (nothing when empty). It lives in `utils/` because every `.ts` under `src/commands/**` is an oclif command (pattern strategy); the seat amended the claim's file surface for it.
- `blank-single-values` and `blank-multi-values` (they share `walkBlankColumns`, so one change covers both), `option-codes`, `text-scalars`: the report gains `withheldColumns`, the human plan prints it, the command's engine view passes `registry`.
- `value-shapes`: the scan is objectql's (`scanValueShapes`) and its column rule (`isScannableValueShapeField`) is not exported, so the command names every withheld field of the scanned objects (no `select`), in the plan and in the `--json` document. No `packages/objectql/**` change.

**Behaviour picked: name the skipped columns, not warn-or-refuse.** Measured on `origin/main` (the integration fixture below with the module disabled): each walk reported `columns: []` over a row still holding a value it would rewrite, so the plan said "✓ No stored empty string found." (and the like) with no mention of the column. Refusing while a module that extends a target object is disabled would block the run for every other object and column it can cover, and the operator's remedy (enable, re-run) is the same either way; naming the columns keeps the run useful and makes the gap explicit. The withheld values cannot be rewritten in place while disabled (the card's out of scope: `engine.find` refuses a withheld field with `INVALID_FIELD`).

Changed lines: 9 files, +321 / −1 (code 5 command files +58/−1, helper +89, tests +164, changeset +10).

## Tests

- `src/commands/migrate/withheld-extension-columns.integration.test.ts` (integration tier: `new ObjectQL(` + sqlite `SqlDriver`): an app package owns `wx_account`, a module package adds `wx_tier` / `wx_level` (select), `wx_tags` (multiselect), `wx_note` (text) by extension; a row below the door holds a value for each walk to rewrite. Per walk: control (enabled: the column is read, nothing named) and the pin (disabled: `report.columns` empty, `withheldColumns` equals the walk's in-scope extension columns with the package id, the plan prints `wx_account.COLUMN (package com.qa.wx.loyalty)`). One more case for the value-shapes path (no column rule: all four fields named).
- `src/utils/migrate-withheld-columns.test.ts` (unit): attribution, the column-rule narrowing, an engine without the registry surface, the empty format.

<details><summary>Ablation (the four command files reverted to origin/main, helper and test kept; commit c2cdd7d5)</summary>

- Mutated leg: `grep -c withheldColumns` on the four files = 0 each; `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)` (every walk case red, e.g. `expected undefined to deeply equal [ Array(2) ]`; the value-shapes helper case stays green as it does not go through a walk). Lock `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
- Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD -- FILES`, `git diff HEAD` empty, each file's hash equals its HEAD blob.
- Fixed tree: `Tests 9 passed (9)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The CLI tests import `src/` directly, so no dist rebuild sits between the legs.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `value-shapes --apply` still records the `adr-0104-value-shapes` deployment flag on a full-scope run while withheld columns went unscanned; this PR only names them. Whether such a run should record no flag (as a `--object`-narrowed run does) is a posture question for the seat; carrier: none.
- Other `os migrate` commands that read `engine.getObject` (`files-to-references`, `comment-reactions`, `activity-changed-fields`, the `audit-*` commands, `organization-ownership`) target platform objects or a scan in objectql; not measured for this blind spot here. carrier: none.

## Verification

Local, on c2cdd7d5 (the implementation head; b94187d7 only merges 4 `origin/main` commits, none touching `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/**` or `packages/cli/src/utils/migrate-*`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (includes `check:test-typecheck`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 390 passed (390)`, `Tests 5435 passed (5435)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Integration layer, the files this diff touches or feeds (new pin + `blank-single-values`, `blank-multi-values`, `option-codes`, `text-scalars` integration suites + the helper unit test): the four sibling integration suites and the helper unit test `5 passed`; the new pin, rerun after a fixture fix, `Tests 9 passed (9)`. The rest of the integration layer is declared to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 60 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; 56 exit 0 first pass, 4 exit 3 (no dist: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) cleared by a whole-tree `turbo run build` and then exit 0. `--ran`: "60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
